SELECT fin.finprod_market_id prodId, fin.finprod_abbr productShortname, fin.finprod_name productName,
finadd.PORTFOLIO_ID assetsPool, zh.portfolio_name assetsPoolName, sale.prd_band type, sale.prd_band productTypeName, finadd.sale_department saleDept, prodTrad.Ccy subscriptionCcy, NVL(finadd.sale_period, '0') rollTerm, prodTrad.Vdate valueDate, prodTrad.Mdate expiryDate, prodTrad.Mdate - prodTrad.Vdate term, prodTrad.Prin_Amt - prodTrad.Trade_Amt amt, prodTrad.Trade_Amt subscriptionAmt, prodTrad.Prin_Amt corpus, fin.entrust_type issueMode, fin.entruster acctBranchId, prodTrad.Yield yield, finadd.sale_department belongDeptCode, 0 affixFileNum FROM fin_product fin, fin_product_add finadd, ptl_portfolio zh, trd_fin_product_deal_total prodTrad, pa_trd_fin_product_deal_total paTrad , prd_sale_param sale
WHERE fin.Finprod_Id =#{finProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.Finprod_Id = finadd.Finprod_Id
AND finadd.PORTFOLIO_ID = zh.portfolio_id AND fin.Finprod_Id = sale.Finprod_Id and paTrad.totle_trade_id = prodTrad.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and prodTrad.Totle_Trade_Id=#{totleTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
